history.summary: A 2015 freehold unit at 18 Woodsville (D13), tagged '1BR' but an 861 sqft / $1.45M / $1,684 psf listing — almost certainly a larger/dual-key format (true 1BRs here are ~500sqft / ~$0.9M), so the bedroom label is mismatched. Sits just 180m from Potong Pasir NEL MRT, is freehold, and at $1,684 psf is ~6.5% below the $1,802 median with a solid 5.8%/yr rate — a well-located value entry, tempered by the misclassification and thin 19-txn data.
history.rating_rationale: Strong fundamentals — freehold, 180m to Potong Pasir MRT, $1,684 psf ~6.5% below the $1,802 URA median, 5.8%/yr appreciation — but the '1BR' tag on an 861sqft/$1.45M unit is a clear bedroom-sqft mismatch (likely 2BR/dual-key), and the rate rests on a thin 19-txn series. The weak 114-195 arena record and 963 Elo reflect the high quantum relative to its 1BR label. Net Neutral leaning positive pending unit-type confirmation.
red_flags: Bedroom-sqft mismatch — 861sqft/$1.45M is not a true 1BR (likely 2BR/dual-key)
Appreciation rate from a thin 19-txn series

catalysts: 180m to Potong Pasir NEL MRT — top-tier doorstep transit
